summary: A blue baize under one lamp with a clerk who keeps a diary — unmistakably its own world on every screen, with a real run, a real ladder and real things earned; its one structural flaw is that the pack holds 200 grade-9 deals, so past rung ~313 the chooser walks back down the grades and session 500 is easier than session 150.
fixes: Play.choose descends the grades once grade 9 at draw three is spent (200 deals): keep the ladder's grade with a per-grade second pass, or pack more top-grade deals, and fix DESIGN.md's 'rung 900' claim

Mastery's choice is invisible and nearly single-valued at grade 9 (166 of 200 are Buried, none Even): put the shape in the table's head caps with one clerk line on laying, and rank grades within each shape in pack.mjs
The win's two actions sit under the fold on a 393 pt phone: cap the fans' height and pin 'Lay No. 52 / Send the card' in a bottom safeAreaInset like OneAction
Today's ending says 'Tomorrow's is laid at midnight' over a button reading 'Lay No. 51': name the ledger's next deal in Voice.nextLine for today's kind
The done state's fans art carries its own dark rounded square on the cloth: strip the background rect from fans.svg and re-render
The ghost hand on the first deal reads as a smudge at 18 % opacity: raise the fingertip and the ghost card so the capture shows the move at a glance
Small craft: HOUNDSTOOTH clipped mid-word with no scroll cue, the dark paywall's second bullet mark invisible, the Diary's today line under the tab bar, the AX win head truncating to 'MONDA…'
